name: Lightfield
long_description: Lightfield is the front door for in-house legal teams. Requests from Gmail, Outlook and Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, and Slack land in one queue with an owner, a status, and the source record. Lightfield also connects with the business systems legal teams already use, including Salesforce, Jira, ServiceNow, Ironclad, Zendesk, and HubSpot. Lightfield, Inc. is based in San Francisco.
one_liner: AI legal intake & triage for in-house teams
